dialogues.speaker: Hidalgo
dialogues.text: Hah! Finally got you! Let's see you run off this time!

dialogues.speaker: Hidalgo
dialogues.text: Breaking fences, overturning grain, and the near-breakage of the blacksmith's roof... You're getting what's coming to you for that, and you're getting it from me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, how is a small lil' Tatankasaurus like that still so strong?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know... Would Paimon get super strong if she trained together with some of 'em? She might even be able to help you knock a Lawachurl flat on its butt... Eh, then again, probably not.
